scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]: a `Json` value one level past the depth limit (17: sixteen nested arrays around one scalar), asserted by the host into a `Json` slot, is refused with `DS_ERR_JSON_LIMIT` (-221). Nothing changes, and NO fault event reaches the stream: the status is the whole host refusal, so `no_fault_events` fails a runtime that records a BoundsError. Paired with LGRA.5.8.6_host_depth_at_limit, one level shallower and admitted. PATH PINNED: on libds, pyds's `pyds_py_to_json_tree_at` refuses at level 17 with libds's status before any node is built, so the engine is never called; on the Mercury runtime, `ds.engine.host_assert` refuses through `ds.fact`'s `sr_json_limit` and writes no effect. Every libds refusal of one names `DS_JSON_MAX_`.
